# `kaolin/ops/conversions/MeshToVoxel.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/ops/conversions/MeshToVoxel.js`

MeshToVoxel.js — Voxelize any triangle mesh Converts a triangle surface mesh into a 3D voxel grid. Uses conservative voxelization: any voxel that overlaps a triangle is set. Approaches: 1. CPU scanline (simple, robust) — default 2. GPU compute (fast, for large meshes) — requires WebGPU device Output: Uint8Array (1 = solid, 0 = empty) indexed [x + y*resX + z*resX*resY] Compatible with: - engine/voxel/ chunk system (ChunkRegistry) - MarchingCubesMesher (feed density field) - ConnectivityCompute (structural analysis) - VoronoiFracture (fracture source)

## Functions

### `meshToVoxel(positions, indices, options = {})`

Voxelize a triangle mesh on the CPU.

**Parameters:**

- `positions` *(Float32Array)* — — stride 3
- `indices` *(Uint32Array)* — — stride 3
- `options` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `options.resolution` *(number)* — — voxels per longest axis (default 32)
- `options.padding` *(number)* — — padding voxels around mesh (default 1)
- `options.fillInterior` *(boolean)* — — flood-fill interior after surface (default false)

**Returns:** }

### `voxelGridToDensity(grid, resX, resY, resZ)`

Convert voxel grid to a density field (Float32Array) for Marching Cubes. Surface voxels get density 0, interior > 0, exterior < 0.

**Parameters:**

- `grid` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resX` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resY` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resZ` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** — density field, same dimensions

### `voxelGridToSDF(grid, resX, resY, resZ, voxelSize)`

Compute a signed distance field from a voxel grid. Uses distance transform (chamfer approximation).

**Parameters:**

- `grid` *(Uint8Array)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resX` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resY` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `resZ` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `voxelSize` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** — signed distance at each voxel center
